text:
sam: quick check — config.json for mosaic-xl onboarding failed schema lint in CI. looks like `tokenizer.default` missing and weights URI uses `s3://models/prod/...` instead of our canonical bucket. anyone seen this pattern?

ci-bot: :x: config-lint failed: missing required field `tokenizer.default` (schema v2). job: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/1245/config-lint

eli: ping @tara for tokenizer quirks — we saw special token id mismatch earlier.

tara: yea. this model's tokenizer uses unk_id=2 not 3. our schema treats `special_tokens.unk` as optional and defaults to 3, so omitting it breaks the runtime mapping. either add `special_tokens` in config or set `tokenizer.default: 2`.

kyle: weights path note: we migrated canonical storage to `s3://redwood-models/weights/`. if the uploaded path is `s3://models/prod/...` infra wants either a copy or a config alias `weights.aliases`. otherwise serving verifies bucket prefix and fails.

sam: current offending snippet (from model repo):
```json
{
  "model": "mosaic-xl",
  "weights_uri": "s3://models/prod/mosaic-xl/weights.bin",
  "tokenizer": {
    "vocab": "s3://models/prod/mosaic-xl/tokenizer.json"
  }
}
```

katie: for a quick unblock: add "tokenizer": {"default": 2} and set "schema_version": "2" in the config. I'll open a tiny PR that also adds "weights": {"aliases": ["s3://models/prod/mosaic-xl/"]} so CI and serving are happy.

sam: sweet — follow-ups: @katie opens PR, @eli will verify tokenizer unk mapping in tests, @infra to copy weights to redwood bucket if needed. i'll re-run lint after the PR lands.

infra: infra: starting copy job for mosaic-xl weights to canonical bucket now, ETA ~12m.

infra: infra: copy complete — new path `s3://redwood-models/weights/mosaic-xl/v1/weights.bin` and token files at `s3://redwood-models/tokenizers/mosaic-xl/v1/tokenizer.json`.

sam: re-running CI... :hourglass:

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: config-lint passed on PR #789 (schema_version=2, tokenizer.default=2, weights.aliases present).

tara: confirmed tokenizer mapping correct after adding default. unit tests for special tokens passed.

sam: merging now. thanks team :rocket:
